name: Seafield Holiday Park (Braddicks)
stayType: Year-round holiday park with caravans and villas
accommodation: Caravans, villas and cottages, including 2-bedroom caravans and villas sleeping up to 10; group bookings available
suitableFor: Families, larger groups, dog owners and guests needing mobility-friendly units
beachAccess: About a five-minute walk to Westward Ho! beach
confirmedFeatures: Open all year, mobility-friendly units, pet-friendly units, group bookings, backs onto Kipling Tors
overview: Seafield sits on Merley Road in Westward Ho!, backing onto the Kipling Tors clifftop walks and about five minutes' walk from the beach. It offers caravans, villas and cottages across a range of sizes, including larger villas for groups, and stays open all year.
surfTripFit: Open all year, so it works for autumn and winter swells, and the larger villas suit a group of friends sharing a surf trip.
